[[Image:Mostafa Ronaghi.jpg|thumb|right|Mostafa Ronaghi]]
'''Mostafa Ronaghi''' ({{langx|fa|مصطفی رونقی}}; born 1968{{citation needed lead|date=October 2025}}) is an Iranian [[molecular biologist]], specializing in [[DNA sequencing]] methodology. {{As of|2008}}, he was the Chief Technology Officer and Senior Vice President at [[Illumina (company)|Illumina]].<ref name=Illumnina/>{{third party inline|date=October 2025}}

==Early life and education==
{{expand section | with = the usual family and educational content of this section, derived from third-party sources | small = no|date=October 2025}}
Mostafa Ronaghi  was born in 1968.{{where|date=October 2025}}{{cn|date=October 2025}} He earned his Ph.D. from the [[Royal Institute of Technology]] in Sweden in 1998.{{cn|date=October 2025}}

==Career==
{{refimprove section|date=October 2025}}
Ronaghi was a principal investigator and Senior Research Associate at the [[Stanford Genome Technology Center]] at [[Stanford University]], prior to working at [[Illumina (company)|Illumina]]),{{when|date=October 2025}} where he focused on developing analytical techniques for molecular diagnostics.{{cn|date=October 2025}} He is principal investigator for several grants including grants from the [[National Human Genome Research Institute]] (NHGRI), part of the [[National Institutes of Health]] for the development of array-based [[pyrosequencing]].<ref>[http://www.genome.gov/12513210 genome.gov | 2004 Release: NHGRI Seeks Next Generation of Sequencing Technologies<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>{{better source|date=October 2025}}

In 1998, Ronaghi, [[Pål Nyrén|Pål Nyren]], and Mathias Uhlen<ref>{{cite web | title=Mathias Uhlén | url=https://www.kth.se/pro/sysbio/uhlen-group/researchers/mathias-uhlen-1.67763 }}</ref> described a solution-based variant of the [[pyrosequencing]] technology,<ref>{{cite journal | last1 = Ronaghi | first1 = M | last2 = Uhlén | first2 = M | last3 = Nyrén | first3 = P | year = 1998 | title = A sequencing method based on real-time pyrophosphate | journal = Science | volume = 281 | issue = 5375| pages = 363–365 | doi = 10.1126/science.281.5375.363 | pmid = 9705713 | s2cid = 26331871 }}</ref> and co-founded [[Pyrosequencing AB]] (renamed to [[Biotage]] in 2003).{{cn|date=October 2025}} He co-invented [[molecular inversion probe assay]]s,{{what|date=October 2025}}{{cn|date=October 2025}} and co-founded [[ParAllele BioScience]] to develop this multiplexed technology for genetic testing.{{cn|date=October 2025}} ParAllele was acquired by [[Affymetrix]] in May 2005.{{cn|date=October 2025}}

In 2005, Ronaghi co-founded [[NextBio]], a search engine for life science data.<ref name=Illumina2014/>{{verification needed|date=October 2025}} {{As of|2008}}, he was serving as the Chief Technology Officer and Senior Vice President at [[Illumina (company)|Illumina]].<ref name=Illumnina>{{Cite web |url=http://investor.illumina.com/phoenix.zhtml?c=121127&p=irol-newsArticle&ID=1182777&highlight= |title=Illumina {{!}} 2008 Release: Illumina Appoints Mostafa Ronaghi as Senior Vice President and Chief Technology Officer |access-date=2008-08-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081003144414/http://investor.illumina.com/phoenix.zhtml?c=121127&p=irol-newsArticle&ID=1182777&highlight= |archive-date=2008-10-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref>{{third party inline|date=October 2025}}

NextBio was acquired by Illumina in 2013.<ref name=Illumina2014>{{Cite web |url=http://investor.illumina.com/phoenix.zhtml?ID=1869001&c=121127&highlight=&p=irol-newsArticle |title=Illumina {{!}} Illumina Signs Agreement to Acquire NextBio, Leader in Analyzing and Aggregating Complex Genomic Data |access-date=2014-02-12 |archive-date=2014-12-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141226202325/http://investor.illumina.com/phoenix.zhtml?ID=1869001&c=121127&highlight=&p=irol-newsArticle |url-status=dead }}</ref> He also serves on the board of directors of IntegenX and Aurora Biofuels. In 2008, Ronaghi and [[Helmy Eltoukhy]] co-founded [[Avantome]], a DNA sequencing company that was acquired by Illumina in July 2008.<ref>[http://www.tradingmarkets.com/.site/news/Stock%20News/1775391/ tradingmarkets.com | 2008 Release: Illumina To Acquire Privately-Held Avantome For $25 Million In Cash Upfront]{{Dead link|date=October 2019}}</ref><ref name="zz2">{{cite web |url=https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/illumina-snares-sequencing-tech-60m-buyout  |title=Illumina snares sequencing tech in $60M buyout |first=John |last=Carroll|date=23 Jul 2008 |website= fiercebiotech.com|publisher=Questex, LLC |access-date= 19 Oct 2019}}</ref>
